CREATE TABLE "public"."ai_generation_logs" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "error_message" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "input_json" text NOT NULL,
  "output_json" text,
  "prompt_id" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "prompt_version" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  "status" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "ai_generation_logs_status_check_ef2e9b57" CHECK ("status" IN ('success', 'failure'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."daily_minimum_actions" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "date" date NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "minimum_action_id" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."daily_sop_tasks" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "daily_sop_id" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "order_index" int4 NOT NULL,
  "task_id" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."daily_sops" (
  "completed_at" timestamptz,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "date" date NOT NULL,
  "goal_id" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "stage_id" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "daily_sops_status_check_dbabbe3e" CHECK ("status" IN ('pending', 'completed'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."goals" (
  "completed_at" timestamptz,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "current_stage_id" text,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz,
  "description" text,
  "expected_outcome" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "start_date" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
  "target_date" timestamptz,
  "title" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "user_id" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "goals_status_check_bc8d8cc9" CHECK ("status" IN ('active', 'paused', 'completed', 'deleted'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."learning_paths" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "order_index" int4 NOT NULL,
  "source_type" text NOT NULL,
  "stage_id" text NOT NULL,
  "title" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "type" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "learning_paths_source_type_check_64cb7b7d" CHECK ("source_type" IN ('user', 'ai'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."minimum_actions" (
  "completed_at" timestamptz,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "daily_sop_id" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "estimated_minutes" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "task_id" text NOT NULL,
  "title" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."prompt_configs" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "input_schema" text NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "output_schema" text NOT NULL,
  "prompt_id" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "rules" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'active' NOT NULL,
  "system_prompt" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "version" character varying(20) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "prompt_configs_status_check_11063666" CHECK ("status" IN ('active', 'inactive'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."stages" (
  "completed_at" timestamptz,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "duration_days" int4,
  "end_date" timestamptz,
  "goal_id" text NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" character varying(100) NOT NULL,
  "order_index" int4 NOT NULL,
  "start_date" timestamptz,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'not_started' NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "stages_status_check_f5f18e63" CHECK ("status" IN ('not_started', 'in_progress', 'completed'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."tasks" (
  "completed_at" timestamptz,
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "estimated_minutes" int4 NOT NULL,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "learning_path_id" text,
  "order_index" int4 NOT NULL,
  "stage_id" text NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "title" character varying(200) NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "tasks_status_check_dbabbe3e" CHECK ("status" IN ('pending', 'completed'))
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."users" (
  "created_at" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text,
  "id" text NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
